chunks: …of wudu (ablution) before the ghusl (ritual bath), and what indicates that is the statement of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام in the narration of Ibn Abī ʿUmayr: “Every ghusl is preceded by wudu except ghusl al-janābah.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the Imam cited in this report
key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing performed before acts of worship
key_terms.غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ: the ritual bath for janābah, which is excepted here from prior wudu

ai.seo_question: Is wudu required before ghusl according to the hadith of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report indicates a legal distinction between ghusl al-janābah and other forms of ghusl regarding wudu beforehand. It is cited as evidence that wudu is required before every ghusl except the ghusl of janābah.
